body_lead: The Kerala government’s ‘Safe Kerala’ project, under which as many as 726 surveillance cameras powered by artificial intelligence have been installed in the state to prevent traffic violations and reduce road accidents, has been met with criticism from the Opposition Congress and some social media users. After the project was approved in a Cabinet meeting held on April 13, the cameras were inaugurated by Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Thursday, April 20.
